test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
In this question, there are three statements showing the relationship between the letters. Three findings related to them are given i, ii, and iii. Assuming the statements as truth, decide which conclusions are completely true in relation to the statements. 

**Statement :** B > A = C; C ≥ K K 

ii) C < N 

iii) K < G
solution:
**Given Statement:** B > A = C; C ≥ K A = C ≥ K K → True (As B > A = C ≥ K, it gives B > K)

ii) C < N → False (As C ≥ K < I ≤ N, it gives no relation between C and N. So it can be possible but not definitely true.)

iii) K < G → True (As K < I ≤ N < G, it gives K < G)

So, only conclusion I and III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
